summary: Phase 0 evidence collection for the mo-execute-and-fulfill feature: the EXECUTION half of the manufacturing order lifecycle (picking, FIFO/lot consumption, negative-stock warn flow, completion → output lot + cost basis, batch-mode execution) plus downstream SO shipment fulfillment that consumes from MO-produced lots through stock-allocation buckets. SO↔MO link creation, BR-1 one-time-claim, and direct CRUD are explicitly out of scope (Run 1 / so-mo-linkage). All file paths are absolute. Citations point to specific line ranges or symbols and are tagged as facts; interpretive notes are tagged as inferences.

component.name: mo-execute-and-fulfill
component.path: app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts (server) + app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts (shipment consumption) + lib/inventory/kernel/operations/* (kernel) + manufacturing/sales API routes

notable_symbols.name: pickManufacturingIngredient (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Entry point for the pick action. Locks the ingredient row FOR UPDATE, validates remaining qty, enforces minimum-lot-age constraint (returns 409 with shortage.warningType='requirement_violation' unless confirmRequirementOverride=true), then delegates to lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.pickManufacturingIngredientInTx. Translates InsufficientStockError into ManufacturingError 409 with shortage payload (warningType='stock_shortage'). When called for a batch-mode order it also transitions the parent batch from 'pending' to 'in_progress' and stamps batches.pickedAt when fully picked.

notable_symbols.name: pickManufacturingIngredientInTx (kernel)
notable_symbols.why: Core picking primitive: lockItemsInTx → reads ownReservation from inventory_reservations_summary → reads getCurrentAvailableQtyAtLocationInTx → checks `available + ownReservation < quantity && !allowNegativeStock` and throws InsufficientStockError. Then runs held-allocation branch (consumeLotAllocationsForDemandInTx — consumes from existing stock_allocations sales/MO held lots) followed by FIFO branch (consumeStockFifoInTx for the remaining quantity). Inserts manufacturing_pick_allocations rows for each consumed lot (with requirementOverrideConfirmed metadata when minimumReceivedDate is violated). Drops demand reference deltas and reservation reference deltas to zero. Always writes inventory_events rows of type manufacturing_ingredient_consumption with eventSubtype='manufacturing_pick'.

notable_symbols.name: completeManufacturingOrder (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Discrete-MO completion entry. Rejects batch-mode orders (line 5545-5550). If output was already recorded via /outputs, releases remaining ingredient reservations + expected supply and marks the MO 'done' WITHOUT producing again (lines 5555-5597). Otherwise: requires payload.actualQuantity, blocks completion if any ingredient has remaining unpicked planned quantity (returns 400 with shortage payload), reconciles ingredient variance via reconcileIngredientActualsInTx for each supplied actual, calls produceManufacturedStockInTx, persists actualMaterialCost + actualCostPerUnit and writes status='done', priorityRank=null, completedAt. Catches InsufficientStockError into ManufacturingError 409 with shortage.warningType='stock_shortage'.

notable_symbols.name: completeManufacturingBatch (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Batch-mode completion entry. Rejects discrete orders (line 5866-5868). Asserts the current execution batch matches batchId (assertCurrentExecutionBatch). Tracks `completesOrder = batches.every(other === completed || id === batchId)`. If output was pre-recorded for the batch, releases reservations and the batch's planned-batch slice of expected supply, marks the batch row 'completed', and flips parent order to 'done' only when ALL batches are completed. Otherwise: blocks unless all batch ingredients are fully picked, calls reconcileIngredientActualsInTx (referenceType='manufacturing_batch'), then produceManufacturedStockInTx with expectedReleaseQuantity = (completesOrder ? null : actualQuantity), then insertManufacturingOrderOutputInTx, then stamps the batch lot id and parent order actuals.

notable_symbols.name: recordManufacturingOutput (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Implements both POST /outputs (discrete) and POST /batches/[batchId]/outputs (batch). Supports negative quantity (calls reverseManufacturingOutputInTx) to walk back already-produced output. For positive output: rejects discrete orders that pass a batchId (line 4406), proportionally consumes ingredients using the ratio (outputQuantity / plannedOutputQuantity), reuses pickedAllocations first then falls back to consumeLotAllocationsForDemandInTx then consumeStockFifoInTx, calls produceManufacturedStockInTx with lotId reused from getProducedLotIdInTx (so successive outputs for the same MO append to one lot), and expectedReleaseQuantity = outputQuantity. Catches InsufficientStockError into ManufacturingError 409 with shortage.warningType='stock_shortage'.

notable_symbols.name: produceManufacturedStockInTx
notable_symbols.why: Creates the manufactured output lot. Computes unitCost = (ingredientCostTotal + overheadCostTotal)/quantity at scale 6. Calls appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx when lotId provided OR createPositiveStockEventInTx otherwise; writes inventory_events of type 'manufacturing_output' with eventSubtype 'manufacturing_complete'. When outputDisposition === 'available' it then materializes any 'manufacturing_order' source allocations into the produced lot (materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsForLotInTx) — this is the bridge that lets shipments later consume from the produced lot. Finally releases expected supply by min(currentOpenQty, expectedReleaseQuantity).

notable_symbols.name: shipSalesShipment (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Per-shipment fulfillment entry. Locks the order and the shipment row, rejects non-'open' orders, rejects already-shipped shipments. Calls consumeForShipmentInTx with the shipment's lines and `allowNegativeStock: payload.confirmNegativeStock`. Catches InsufficientStockError → throws SalesError(409) carrying a negativeStock payload {itemId, itemName, available, requested, shortage}. On success transitions shipment.status='shipped', shippedAt=now, and flips the order to 'done' when no remaining lines outstanding (or upserts an unscheduled remainder shipment). When the order finalizes and payload.syncAccounting === true, attempts hasShipmentInvoiceForSalesOrder + pushSalesOrderToXero in a best-effort post-tx block.

notable_symbols.name: shipSalesOrder (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: Single-shot order ship (no shipment row). Calls consumeForShipmentInTx with order lines, identical negative-stock warning shape to shipSalesShipment. options.syncAccounting/confirmNegativeStock are part of the idempotency payload via beginInventoryOperationInTx.

notable_symbols.name: consumeForShipmentInTx (kernel)
notable_symbols.why: Shipment-side FIFO + allocation consumer. Locks affected items, loads existing reservations + stock_allocations rows for both sales_order_line AND sales_shipment_line demand types. Branches per line: (a) if the shipment line has 'inventory_lot' allocations on the SHIPMENT-LINE demand, consume those first via the shipment-line demand key; (b) if the sales-order-line is `allocationManagedAt != null` (managed) but no shipment allocations exist, consume from sales_order_line allocations; (c) any unmet remainder falls through to consumeStockFifoInTx for genuine free stock. Critically refuses to fall through to FIFO if the shipment line had any 'manufacturing_order' source allocations and they did not materialize — throws InsufficientStockError (lines 756-768). Drops demand + reservation deltas for the consumed sales_order_line at the end.

notable_symbols.name: consumeStockFifoInTx
notable_symbols.why: Generic FIFO consumer. Selects inventory_lot_balances ORDER BY receivedAt ASC, lotId ASC FOR UPDATE, skipping ineligible lots when minimumReceivedDate is set (unless allowIneligibleLots=true). Honors an `unavailableByLotId` map (lots already held by other demands' active stock_allocations) so it never spends another demand's holds. When `allowNegativeStock=true` and remainder > 0, creates a synthetic NEG-<date>-<uuid> lot via createNegativeStockEventInTx using resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx for cost basis. Without that flag, throws InsufficientStockError(itemId, available, requested).

notable_symbols.name: resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx (cost basis)
notable_symbols.why: Cost basis policy for positive stock events. Materials: explicitUnitCost → items.currentStockUnitCost → resolveStockUnitCostFromDefaultPurchasePrice; otherwise throws MissingCostBasisError. Products: walks the active BOM recursively (getCurrentActiveBomIngredientsInTx) and sums child cost × calculateAverageUnitConsumptionQuantity (handles unit and batch recipe bases). Detects BOM cycles and throws MissingCostBasisError with reason='product_bom_cost'. Used by the negative-stock fallback path during shipping/picking.

notable_symbols.name: consumeLotAllocationsForDemandInTx
notable_symbols.why: Spends held inventory_lot stock_allocations for a given demand (sales_order_line, sales_shipment_line, or manufacturing_order_ingredient) before falling back to FIFO. Locks stock_allocations rows FOR UPDATE and walks them in createdAt order. Calls consumeSpecificLotInTx for each lot allocation. Reduces or marks the allocation 'consumed'. Returns {allocations, eventIds, consumedQuantity, remainingQuantity, idempotencyUsed}.

notable_symbols.name: materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsForLotInTx
notable_symbols.why: Converts open 'manufacturing_order' source promises into concrete 'inventory_lot' source allocations against the produced lot. Walks active stock_allocations rows where sourceType='manufacturing_order' AND sourceId=producing MO, intersects each promise with the demand's remaining open qty (getOpenDemandQtyForAllocationInTx considers shipped/planned for sales_order_line, planned for sales_shipment_line, picked/actualQuantity for manufacturing_order_ingredient), holds that intersection on the produced lot, and excess promise quantity is cancelled. After holds, calls syncSalesLineStockReservationFromLotAllocationsInTx so the inventory_reservations_summary tracks the new lot-level reservation.

notable_symbols.name: reconcileIngredientActualsInTx
notable_symbols.why: Closes the gap between pickedQuantity and actualConsumedQuantity at completion. delta > +epsilon → consume more stock (held first, then FIFO) and append new manufacturing_pick_allocations rows with eventType 'manufacturing_variance_loss'. delta < -epsilon → restockExistingLotInTx for the most-recently-allocated rows, deleting/shrinking the manufacturing_pick_allocations row, eventType 'manufacturing_variance_gain'. Returns aggregated newTotalQuantity and newTotalCost which become the ingredient's actualQuantity/actualCostTotal.

notable_symbols.name: saveManufacturingOutputAllocation (DAL)
notable_symbols.why: PUT /output-allocation. Lets a user redirect a released MO's expected output across sales_order_line / sales_shipment_line / manufacturing_order_ingredient demands. Cancels existing active stock_allocations whose source is this MO OR produced output lots, validates each destination still needs the qty, and re-inserts new active rows. After insertion, if the MO already has produced output rows, calls materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsFromExistingOutputInTx to immediately materialize promises against existing output lots.

notable_symbols.name: ManufacturingError (domain)
notable_symbols.why: Domain error returned via error.toResponse() from the routes. shortage payload type is ManufacturingReleaseWarningPayload (defined in app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/types.ts) and carries per-ingredient {itemId, itemName, unitName, needed, available, shortage, warningType: 'stock_shortage' | 'requirement_violation', requirement?, nextEligibleDate?}.

notable_symbols.name: SalesError + NegativeStockWarningPayload
notable_symbols.why: Domain error specialized for shipment flows. SalesError.toResponse() emits {error, negativeStock} when a negativeStock payload is attached. NegativeStockWarningPayload type lives in app/(dashboard)/sales/types.ts lines 675-681 (fields: itemId, itemName, available, requested, shortage).

notable_symbols.name: completeManufacturingOrderSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: Accepts {actualQuantity?, outputDisposition: 'available'|'blocked' default 'available', ingredientActuals: [{ingredientId, actualConsumedQuantity}], confirmNegativeStock?}.

notable_symbols.name: completeManufacturingBatchSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: Same shape as completeManufacturingOrderSchema; routed at /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/batches/[batchId]/complete.

notable_symbols.name: pickManufacturingIngredientSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: {confirmRequirementOverride?, confirmNegativeStock?} — both optional booleans. Body is the only place to acknowledge the two distinct 409 warnings.

notable_symbols.name: recordManufacturingOutputSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: {quantity: non-zero string (allows negative for output reversal), outputDisposition: 'available'|'blocked', notes?, confirmNegativeStock?}.

notable_symbols.name: saveManufacturingOutputAllocationSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: {salesAllocations: [{salesOrderLineId, quantity}], productionAllocations: [{ingredientId, quantity}]} — no idempotency required by PUT /output-allocation route.

notable_symbols.name: salesShipmentInputSchema, shipSalesShipmentSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: salesShipmentInputSchema accepts fulfillmentType ('delivery'|'pickup'), scheduledDate, deliveryDate, notes, splitFromShipmentId?, lines[]. shipSalesShipmentSchema accepts {syncAccounting?, confirmNegativeStock?}.

notable_symbols.name: salesShipmentCostsInputSchema (Zod)
notable_symbols.why: Shipment-cost write endpoint. Costs are pure margin entries (cost_type IN freight/delivery_labor/fuel/packaging/accessorial/other); does NOT trigger any inventory or accounting mutation. updateSalesShipmentCosts (app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts lines 6921-6981) only writes sales_shipments + sales_shipment_costs rows.

notable_symbols.name: salesShipments + salesShipmentLines + salesShipmentCosts (schema)
notable_symbols.why: salesShipments.status CHECK IN ('planned','shipped'); fulfillmentType IN ('delivery','pickup'); shipped state requires shippedAt non-null (check constraint at lines 588-591). salesShipmentLines has unique (salesShipmentId, salesOrderLineId) and quantity > 0. salesShipmentCosts uses (costType, costStatus) with cost_type CHECK at line 627.

notable_symbols.name: manufacturingOrders + manufacturingOrderIngredients + manufacturingOrderBatches + manufacturingPickAllocations + manufacturingOrderOutputs + manufacturingOrderOutputConsumptions
notable_symbols.why: Critical columns: manufacturingOrders {requestedQuantity, plannedQuantity, actualQuantity, actualMaterialCost, actualCostPerUnit, completedAt, manufacturingMode 'discrete'|'batch'}. manufacturingOrderBatches {batchNumber, status default 'pending', plannedQuantity, actualQuantity, startedAt, pickedAt, completedAt, lotId} with unique (manufacturingOrderId, batchNumber). manufacturingPickAllocations {manufacturingOrderIngredientId, lotId, quantityUsed, costPerUnit, requirementOverrideConfirmed, requirementOverrideConfirmedBy/At, createdBy} — append-only pick history per ingredient. manufacturingOrderOutputs {outputNumber, lotId, quantity, disposition 'available'|'blocked', unitCost, materialCostTotal, notes} with unique (manufacturingOrderId, outputNumber). manufacturingOrderOutputConsumptions joins each output to the picks it consumed.

notable_symbols.name: stockAllocations (schema)
notable_symbols.why: Demand types: 'sales_order_line' (unplanned residual), 'sales_shipment_line' (planned), 'manufacturing_order_ingredient' (consumes only — never appears as MO ingredient HELD via UI). Source types: 'inventory_lot' (concrete held lot), 'manufacturing_order' (promise that hasn't produced yet). Status: 'active' | 'consumed' | 'cancelled'. Unique index (org, demandType, demandId, sourceType, sourceId) WHERE status='active'.

notable_symbols.name: inventoryEvents + INVENTORY_EVENT_TYPES (schema)
notable_symbols.why: Authoritative ledger. Relevant types: manufacturing_output (positive product lot, requires lot+cost), manufacturing_ingredient_consumption (negative material), manufacturing_variance_gain/loss (reconciliation deltas), sales_consumption (shipment-driven negative), unpick_restock, reservation_increase/release, demand_increase/release, expected_increase/release. Unique idempotency_key per (org, idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null.

notable_symbols.name: inventoryIdempotencyClaims (schema)
notable_symbols.why: Underlies beginInventoryOperationInTx / finishInventoryOperationInTx replay. Unique (organizationId, idempotencyKey). resultEnvelope holds {status: 'pending'} until completed, then the full result. claimInventoryIdempotencyInTx throws IdempotencyConflictError (409) on mismatched paramsHash and IdempotencyInFlightError (409) when concurrent.

notable_symbols.name: InsufficientStockError + MissingCostBasisError
notable_symbols.why: InsufficientStockError carries {itemId, available, requested} and status 409. Routes catch it explicitly and translate to {error: message} 409. MissingCostBasisError 400 carries {itemId, reason} with reasons 'opening_cost_required' | 'material_default_price' | 'product_bom_cost' | 'stocktake_cost_policy' | 'negative_stock_cost_policy'.

notable_symbols.name: lockItemsInTx, lockSourceDocumentInTx
notable_symbols.why: INVENTORY_LOCK_SPECS maps each kernel operation to a source-table FOR UPDATE lock (pickManufacturingIngredient → manufacturing_orders, consumeForShipment → sales_orders, etc.). lockItemsInTx sorts itemIds before locking to prevent deadlocks.

notable_symbols.name: requireIdempotencyKey (API)
notable_symbols.why: Throws MissingIdempotencyKeyError (400) when 'Idempotency-Key' header is missing. Used by ALL pick/complete/output endpoints listed in api_files. Not used by /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/duplicate/route.ts or PUT /output-allocation.

notable_symbols.name: createIdempotencyHeaders (client)
notable_symbols.why: UI helper that stamps 'Idempotency-Key: <op>:<uuid>' onto outgoing fetches. Test helper testFetch (test/helpers/api.ts lines 135-177) uses createIdempotencyHeaders with a deterministic per-(method, path, body-hash) key so retries replay correctly.

notable_symbols.name: manufacturingExecution component
notable_symbols.why: UI for /execute pages. Polls every 5s (EXECUTION_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS, line 67). Sends pick/complete/output mutations with createIdempotencyHeaders. Renders ManufacturingPickProgressBadge and per-ingredient pick buttons; complete dialog gates on canComplete from the execution detail.

notable_symbols.name: salesOrderLineAllocationAdapter / salesShipmentLineAllocationAdapter
notable_symbols.why: Defines how sales-line vs shipment-line demand is loaded and how syncSalesLineAllocationReservationInTx keeps inventory_reservations_summary in sync with sum(inventory_lot allocations) on both the sales-line and any shipment-line under it. afterSaveAllocationsInTx on sales_order_line also stamps salesOrderLines.allocationManagedAt / allocationManagedBy (lines 282-305).

notable_symbols.name: getCurrentActiveBomIngredientsInTx (referenced)
notable_symbols.why: Used by resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx (cost basis) and by manufacturability summaries. Loading it is out of scope here; flagged as an unknown for downstream phases.

suspected_risk_areas.area: FIFO lot consumption: held vs FIFO branches in pickManufacturingIngredientInTx
suspected_risk_areas.evidence: pickManufacturingIngredientInTx first calls consumeLotAllocationsForDemandInTx for the ingredient's own held lots, then consumeStockFifoInTx for the remainder, passing an unavailableByLotId map that EXCLUDES the ingredient's own demand. lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts lines 381-430.
risks: Race where another demand allocates the same lot between availability calculation (line 366) and lot locking (consumeStockFifoInTx)
Held vs FIFO accounting drift if heldConsumed.idempotencyUsed is mishandled when remaining=0 and FIFO branch never runs
unavailableByLotId computed AFTER the held branch consumes — ensures held lots aren't double-counted, but the order matters

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: Pick: ManufacturingError 409 with shortage.warningType='stock_shortage' (app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts lines 6388-6406) and warningType='requirement_violation' for lot-age (lines 6326-6350). Override: confirmNegativeStock=true + confirmRequirementOverride=true via pickManufacturingIngredientSchema (lib/schemas/manufacturing-orders.ts lines 258-261). DAL ORs them: `confirmNegativeStock || confirmRequirementOverride` (lines 6212-6213). Ship: SalesError 409 with negativeStock payload (app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts lines 7197-7213 and 7373-7387), confirmNegativeStock unlocks `allowNegativeStock=true` into consumeForShipmentInTx which then runs negative-lot creation via createNegativeStockEventInTx (stock-core.ts lines 942-973).
risks: Negative-stock NEG-<date>-<uuid> lots must still resolve a cost basis via resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx with reason='negative_stock_cost_policy'; products without an active BOM will fail late with MissingCostBasisError instead of a clear shortage 409
shipSalesShipment retries that supply only confirmNegativeStock=false on the second attempt after a 409 risk reverting to the warn path

Idempotency hash includes confirmNegativeStock in the payload (shipSalesOrder lines 7315-7319), so a second attempt with a different flag is an IdempotencyConflictError 409 instead of executing the override

suspected_risk_areas.area: Cost-basis propagation (currentStockUnitCost on materials; BOM-derived cost on products; weighted-average on positive flow)
suspected_risk_areas.evidence: resolveStockUnitCostFromDefaultPurchasePrice (lib/inventory/cost.ts lines 7-26). calculateNextCurrentStockUnitCost weighted-average (lib/inventory/cost.ts lines 28-54). produceManufacturedStockInTx computes unitCost = totalCost/quantity at scale 6 (lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts line 652). appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx weighted-averages BOTH lot quantity and unit cost on every output that targets an existing lot (lib/inventory/kernel/operations/stock-core.ts lines 567-579). resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx walks active BOM for products and detects cycles (stock-core.ts lines 247-364).
risks: Second /outputs call on a discrete MO reuses producedLotId and weighted-averages into the FIRST output's unit cost — variance reconciliation at /complete may then produce an actualCostPerUnit inconsistent with the lot's unitCost

MissingCostBasisError thrown deep inside produceManufacturedStockInTx surfaces as a generic 500 (no explicit catch in routes for MissingCostBasisError; only InsufficientStockError + ManufacturingError are caught — see app/api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/complete/route.ts lines 24-30)
Products with cyclic BOM throw MissingCostBasisError(reason='product_bom_cost') deep in resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx — same 500 risk

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: addExpectedFromManufacturingInTx / editExpectedFromManufacturingInTx write expected_increase/release inventory_events (lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts lines 35-155). produceManufacturedStockInTx releases expected by min(currentOpenQty, expectedReleaseQuantity) at the produce step (lines 692-732). completeManufacturingOrder releases ALL remaining expected via releaseRemainingExpectedOutputInTx (app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts line 5571). completeManufacturingBatch only releases the per-batch slice unless it's the final batch (lines 5915-5928, 5922-5928).
risks: Batch-mode partial-completion bookkeeping: if the final batch's plannedQuantity differs from the order's total remaining expected, the residual may leak as expected_increase that's never released
Recording output via /outputs route uses expectedReleaseQuantity=outputQuantity, then completing the same MO sees outputQuantity>0 and skips production — only releases REMAINING expected qty
/output-allocation does NOT recompute expected supply; only cancels/inserts stock_allocations

suspected_risk_areas.area: One-lot-per-batch invariant for batch-mode MO completion
suspected_risk_areas.evidence: manufacturingOrderBatches.lotId column. completeManufacturingBatch sets that row.lotId from produceManufacturedStockInTx (app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts line 6142). Output reuses getProducedLotIdInTx so successive output rows append to one lot per parent MO (recordManufacturingOutput lines 4658-4673). However batch-mode produce calls do NOT pass an explicit lotId — produceManufacturedStockInTx falls through to createPositiveStockEventInTx and creates a NEW lot per batch (lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts lines 674-679).
risks: If recordManufacturingOutput is invoked for a batch-mode order, producedLotId is order-level; output across multiple batches would append to the same lot, while completeManufacturingBatch creates one lot per batch — divergence between the two execution paths
Direct parent /complete call on a batch-mode order is explicitly rejected (lines 5545-5550); test must cover this guard, not bypass it

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: createSalesShipment pulls unplanned sales_order_line allocations into the new shipment line via pullUnplannedSalesAllocationsToShipmentLineInTx and on split uses moveShipmentLineAllocationsInTx (app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts lines 6779-6791 and 6736-6766). updateSalesShipment calls replaceShipmentLinesPreservingAllocationsInTx (line 6868). deleteSalesShipment cancelShipmentLineAllocationsInTx (line 7044). syncSalesLineAllocationReservationInTx then reconciles inventory_reservations_summary against the sum of inventory_lot allocations on both the sales-line and any shipment-lines under it (allocation/adapters/sales-order-line.ts lines 223-248).
risks: Manufacturing 'manufacturing_order' source allocations are NOT moved when a shipment splits — only inventory_lot ones (commands.ts validateSourceInTx confirms only inventory_lot, manufacturing_order are valid sources; move helpers may treat MO promises differently)

syncSalesLineStockReservationFromLotAllocationsInTx (operations/stock-allocations.ts lines 156-240) drops the reservation delta to zero on consume; if an allocation is materialised from MO at the same instant a shipment ships, ordering is sensitive

consumeForShipmentInTx will throw InsufficientStockError(itemId, line.quantity-remaining, line.quantity) when a manufacturing_order promise is still active on the shipment line (operations/sales.ts lines 756-768)

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: POST /complete requires it (app/api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/complete/route.ts line 14). POST /pick requires it (ingredients/[ingredientId]/pick/route.ts line 12). POST /outputs (both discrete and batch variants) requires it (outputs/route.ts line 13 and batches/[batchId]/outputs/route.ts line 13). POST /batches/[batchId]/complete requires it. POST /batches/[batchId]/start does NOT (start/route.ts has no requireIdempotencyKey call). PUT /output-allocation does NOT (output-allocation/route.ts has no requireIdempotencyKey). POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/duplicate does NOT (duplicate/route.ts has no requireIdempotencyKey). POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/duplicate DOES (sales-orders/[id]/duplicate/route.ts line 8). POST /shipments and /shipments/[id]/ship require it. PUT /shipments/[id]/costs does NOT (costs/route.ts has no requireIdempotencyKey).
risks: Missing Idempotency-Key on /pick or /complete returns 400 via MissingIdempotencyKeyError — easy to miss in a Playwright manual fetch; testFetch helper auto-injects with a stable hash so tests rarely hit this

PUT /output-allocation, POST /batches/[batchId]/start, POST /duplicate (MO), and PUT /shipments/[id]/costs are NOT idempotent — repeated client retries may double-cancel allocations, double-start batches, etc.
Idempotency payload for consumeForShipmentInTx includes shippedAt as ISO string (operations/sales.ts lines 528-532) — replays use the original shippedAt, never the retry's

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: updateSalesShipmentCosts (app/(dashboard)/sales/queries.ts lines 6921-6981) only writes sales_shipments.customerFreightChargeAmount and sales_shipment_costs rows — no inventory_events, no Xero push, no AP. Schema CHECK constraint at lib/db/schema/sales.ts line 634 ensures amount > 0 but does not gate inventory.
risks: Adding cost rows after shipped status must not retrigger consumeForShipmentInTx

PUT route is not idempotent so duplicate POSTs would create duplicate cost rows — current implementation hard-deletes all costs and re-inserts (lines 6957-6959), so the result is idempotent in effect even though no key is enforced

suspected_risk_areas.evidence: lockItemsInTx is called at the top of every kernel stock primitive: createPositiveStockEventInTx (line 419), appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx (line 524), decrementExistingLotStockInTx (line 679), consumeStockFifoInTx (line 850), consumeSpecificLotInTx (line 1121), restockExistingLotInTx (line 1260), pickManufacturingIngredientInTx (line 354), consumeForShipmentInTx (lines 540-543). FIFO lot rows are .for('update') in getLockedFifoLotsInTx (stock-core.ts lines 794-826). Stock allocations are .for('update') in consumeLotAllocationsForDemandInTx (line 437) and in insertOrIncreaseLotAllocationInTx (line 99) and materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsForLotInTx (line 522). Manufacturing pick allocations are .for('update') in the negative-delta branch of reconcileIngredientActualsInTx (line 981). manufacturingOrderIngredients rows are locked individually in pickManufacturingIngredient (queries.ts line 6267) and batch state rows in getLockedBatchStateRowsInTx (line 1824).
risks: Concurrent pick on the same MO ingredient is serialised by the FOR UPDATE on the ingredient row plus the FOR UPDATE on items — but two ingredients sharing the same item are serialised only on the item row, not on each other

Concurrent /outputs calls on the same MO race on getProducedLotIdInTx (only one will see no existing lot and create); appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx also takes lots row FOR UPDATE — verify replay safety
lockSourceDocumentInTx ensures the parent SO/MO row is locked before any kernel write tied to that source

suspected_risk_areas.area: MO output reversal via negative quantity to /outputs
suspected_risk_areas.evidence: recordManufacturingOutput accepts payload.quantity < 0 and calls reverseManufacturingOutputInTx (app/(dashboard)/manufacturing/queries.ts lines 4301-4361; reverseManufacturingOutputInTx body at lines 2230-2400+).
risks: Reversing more than the recorded actual output is blocked at line 2249-2250 (ManufacturingError 'Output cannot be reduced below zero.') but the schema validator (line 326) only forbids exactly zero — large negatives slip past Zod

evidence.claim: POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/complete requires Idempotency-Key, runs completeManufacturingOrder, and translates InsufficientStockError → 409 and ManufacturingError → its toResponse().

POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/ingredients/[ingredientId]/pick requires Idempotency-Key, parses pickManufacturingIngredientSchema (confirmRequirementOverride?, confirmNegativeStock?), and only catches ManufacturingError.
POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/outputs and POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/batches/[batchId]/outputs both call recordManufacturingOutput; the batch variant passes batchId through.
POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/batches/[batchId]/start does NOT require an Idempotency-Key (no requireIdempotencyKey call) and only catches ManufacturingError.
PUT /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/output-allocation does NOT require an Idempotency-Key; GET is gated by assertModuleReadAccess and PUT by assertModuleWriteAccess.
POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/duplicate does NOT require an Idempotency-Key but POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/duplicate DOES.
evidence.location: MO duplicate/route.ts lines 9-25 (no requireIdempotencyKey); SO duplicate/route.ts lines 6-23 (requireIdempotencyKey on line 8)

evidence.claim: completeManufacturingOrder rejects batch-mode orders with status 400 ('Batch-mode orders must be completed one batch at a time.').
completeManufacturingOrder blocks completion when any ingredient has remaining unpicked planned quantity and returns 400 with shortage payload listing the unpicked ingredients.

completeManufacturingOrder reuses persisted pick allocations and writes manufacturing_order_outputs + manufacturing_order_output_consumptions; it never re-deducts stock at completion when no ingredient variance is supplied.
Discrete /complete catches InsufficientStockError thrown by reconcileIngredientActualsInTx and rethrows as ManufacturingError 409 with shortage payload (warningType='stock_shortage').

completeManufacturingBatch only flips parent MO to 'done' when batches.every(... === 'completed') and only fully releases expected supply on the last batch; intermediate batches release only the slice (plannedBatchQuantity - outputQuantity).
Batch completion calls produceManufacturedStockInTx WITHOUT passing lotId, so each batch creates a new lot via createPositiveStockEventInTx and stores it on manufacturingOrderBatches.lotId.
evidence.location: queries.ts lines 6095-6108 (no lotId param); operations/manufacturing.ts lines 674-679 (lotId branching)

evidence.claim: recordManufacturingOutput supports negative quantity (output reversal) and routes through reverseManufacturingOutputInTx; positive output reuses producedLotId from getProducedLotIdInTx so subsequent outputs append to the same lot via appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx.
recordManufacturingOutput rejects discrete orders that pass a batchId with 400 'Discrete orders cannot record batch output.'.
pickManufacturingIngredient locks the ingredient row FOR UPDATE; if remainingQuantity <= 0 it throws ManufacturingError 400 '<itemName> is already picked.'.

pickManufacturingIngredient enforces minimum lot age: if ageAvailability.eligible < remainingQuantity and confirmRequirementOverride !== true, it throws ManufacturingError 409 with shortage.warningType='requirement_violation' and nextEligibleDate.
Manufacturing pick override semantics: the DAL ORs the two confirm flags so any negative-stock confirmation also acts as a requirement override.

pickManufacturingIngredientInTx (kernel) first consumes held lot allocations for the ingredient, then falls back to FIFO with an unavailableByLotId map that excludes the ingredient's own demand; inserts manufacturing_pick_allocations rows with requirementOverrideConfirmed metadata when a lot violated the minimumReceivedDate.
pickManufacturingIngredientInTx throws InsufficientStockError when (available + ownReservation) < quantity AND allowNegativeStock !== true.

consumeStockFifoInTx supports allowNegativeStock and, when triggered, creates a synthetic NEG-<date>-<uuid> lot via createNegativeStockEventInTx using resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx for cost basis (reason='negative_stock_cost_policy').

produceManufacturedStockInTx computes unitCost = (ingredientCostTotal + overheadCostTotal) / quantity at scale 6, writes inventory_events of type 'manufacturing_output' subtype 'manufacturing_complete', and materializes manufacturing_order source allocations into the produced lot when outputDisposition='available'.
produceManufacturedStockInTx releases expected supply by min(currentOpenQty, expectedReleaseQuantity); expectedReleaseQuantity=null means 'release all open'.

appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx weighted-averages the lot's unitCost: newUnitCost = (currentQuantity*currentUnitCost + addedQuantity*incomingUnitCost) / (currentQuantity+addedQuantity) at scale 6.
Lot numbers default to LOT-YYYY-MM-DD, then LOT-YYYY-MM-DD-01, LOT-YYYY-MM-DD-02 ... via generateDateLotNumberInTx using the org's time zone (default America/Denver).

Material running cost order: items.currentStockUnitCost → resolveStockUnitCostFromDefaultPurchasePrice(defaultPurchasePrice, purchaseToStockFactor). Without either, MissingCostBasisError(reason='material_default_price') is thrown.

Product cost is derived from active BOM ingredients; getCurrentActiveBomIngredientsInTx returns the components and calculateAverageUnitConsumptionQuantity computes per-output average for unit and batch recipe bases.

shipSalesShipment locks the order, locks the shipment row, rejects non-'open' orders and already-'shipped' shipments, then calls consumeForShipmentInTx with allowNegativeStock=payload.confirmNegativeStock.
shipSalesShipment maps InsufficientStockError → SalesError(409) with a negativeStock payload {itemId, itemName, available, requested, shortage} sourced from the failing shipment line.

After shipping a shipment, the parent sales order is flipped to 'done' (and shipped Xero push fires) only when every order line's remaining-to-ship is 0; otherwise an unscheduled remainder shipment is upserted.

shipSalesOrder is a single-shot ship-without-shipment path; same negative-stock translation but with options.confirmNegativeStock instead of payload field; the idempotency payload includes syncAccounting and confirmNegativeStock, so a retry with different flags collides via IdempotencyConflictError 409.

consumeForShipmentInTx loads the shipment-line allocations (sales_shipment_line demand) AND the parent sales-line allocations (sales_order_line demand) so a managed sales line falls back to its own allocations when no shipment-level holds exist.
consumeForShipmentInTx refuses to fall through to FIFO when the shipment line has remaining 'manufacturing_order' source holds — it raises InsufficientStockError before consumeStockFifoInTx.
consumeForShipmentInTx drops both demand_release and reservation_release events for the consumed sales_order_line at the end of the operation (full -line.quantity).

saveManufacturingOutputAllocation cancels active stock_allocations whose source is the MO itself OR any of its produced output lots, then re-inserts allocations across normalizedSales (sales_order_line) and normalizedProduction (manufacturing_order_ingredient).
updateSalesShipmentCosts only writes sales_shipments.customerFreightChargeAmount and sales_shipment_costs rows; it does not call any inventory kernel function or Xero push.
manufacturingOrderBatches has unique (manufacturingOrderId, batchNumber), default status 'pending', and a lotId column that references inventory.lots.

manufacturingPickAllocations stores quantityUsed (12,4), costPerUnit (18,6), requirementOverrideConfirmed (boolean), requirementOverrideConfirmedBy/At, and createdBy; cascades from manufacturingOrderIngredients.
manufacturingOrderOutputs has disposition CHECK IN ('available','blocked') and a unique (manufacturingOrderId, outputNumber); manufacturingOrderOutputConsumptions joins outputs to the picks consumed.
salesShipments.status CHECK is ('planned','shipped'); shipped requires shippedAt non-null via CHECK constraint.
salesShipmentCosts.amount has CHECK amount > 0 and costType CHECK IN ('freight','delivery_labor','fuel','packaging','accessorial','other').

stockAllocations active row is unique on (org, demandType, demandId, sourceType, sourceId) WHERE status='active' (lines 87-95). Demand types include 'manufacturing_order_ingredient' but only sales demands are exposed via the allocation UI (allocation/types.ts AllocationDemandType is sales-only).

inventory_events check constraints: event quantity > 0 (except stocktake_verification and cost_basis_change which require quantity = 0); stock-affecting types require lot_id and unit_cost; reservation/demand/expected/cost events require lot_id IS NULL, unit_cost IS NULL, extended_cost IS NULL; unique (org, idempotency_key) where idempotency_key IS NOT NULL.

inventoryIdempotencyClaims is uniquely indexed on (organizationId, idempotencyKey); resultEnvelope holds {status:'pending'} until finalised. Mismatched paramsHash → IdempotencyConflictError 409; in-flight → IdempotencyInFlightError 409.
items.currentStockUnitCost is numeric(18,6) and is the persisted item-level cost basis for materials; products do not use it (cost flows through BOM walk).

lockItemsInTx sorts itemIds and runs SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the items table to deadlock-proof concurrent stock mutations; lockSourceDocumentInTx maps every kernel operation to a parent SO/PO/MO/stocktake row lock.

ManufacturingError.toResponse() emits {error, errors?, extra: {shortage?}}; the shortage payload type is per-ingredient {itemId, itemName, unitName, needed, available, shortage, warningType: 'stock_shortage' | 'requirement_violation', requirement?, nextEligibleDate?}.
evidence.location: queries.ts lines 706-731 (class); shortage warningType strings at queries.ts lines 5704 and 6341/6399

evidence.claim: SalesError.toResponse() emits {error, negativeStock} when negativeStock is set, otherwise {error, errors?} or {error}. NegativeStockWarningPayload = {itemId, itemName, available, requested, shortage}.

test/e2e/fixtures.ts injects the session cookie automatically and exposes a `db` fixture that wraps every query in a transaction that sets `app.current_org_id`. There is no separate beforeEach for auth.

test/helpers/api.ts.testFetch auto-injects an Idempotency-Key derived from `${method}:${path}:<body-hash>` for every non-GET/HEAD request, so retries replay correctly. createItem/createSalesOrder/createCustomer/createManufacturingOrder/releaseManufacturingOrder/completeManufacturingOrder/confirmSalesOrder are exported helpers.

test/helpers/api.ts.completeManufacturingOrder signature is (id, actualQuantity, {outputDisposition?}); it does NOT support ingredientActuals — slow tests bypass this helper when they need variance reconciliation.

test/e2e/slow/manufacturing-order.spec.ts is the breadth model (~2400 lines), is configured `mode: 'serial'`, and uses local helpers (createCustomer, createSalesOrder, confirmSalesOrder, updateSalesOrder) declared at file scope rather than the shared test/helpers/api.ts versions.

test/e2e/fast/manufacturing-actuals.spec.ts exercises batch start/pick/complete (one batch at a time) with under- and over-consumption variance, asserting manufacturing_variance_gain/loss inventory_events rows and reconciled ingredient.actualQuantity.
test/e2e/slow/partial-sales-shipments.spec.ts asserts demand/reservation deltas after partial ship via inventoryDemandSummary / inventoryReservationsSummary / inventoryItemBalances.

test/e2e/reconciliation/kernel-invariants.spec.ts uses `diffProjections` from lib/inventory/kernel/reconcile to assert ledger ↔ projection consistency after each transition; signals the expected pattern for projection assertions in new tests.
manufacturing-execution UI sends pick/complete/output mutations with createIdempotencyHeaders('manufacturing-complete' / similar) and polls every 5s (EXECUTION_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS = 5000).

inferences.claim: Because /complete refuses batch-mode and rejects unpicked ingredients before producing output, every Playwright completion test for a batch product must drive completeManufacturingBatch (POST /batches/[batchId]/complete) batch-by-batch, never POST /complete on the parent MO.

Negative-stock override flow has THREE distinct 409 surfaces with different override flags: pick stock_shortage (confirmNegativeStock), pick requirement_violation (confirmRequirementOverride), and ship negativeStock (confirmNegativeStock at top-level options). Tests that cover the warn → confirm round-trip must read SalesError.negativeStock vs ManufacturingError.shortage from the 409 body and dispatch a second request with the correct override.

Because the idempotency payload for shipSalesOrder includes confirmNegativeStock, a Playwright test that retries with the override after a 409 must use a NEW Idempotency-Key. The shared testFetch helper hashes the body, so toggling confirmNegativeStock automatically yields a new key — but a future helper that pins the key would create false 409s.

MO output reversal via POST /outputs with negative quantity is a less-tested edge: schema allows any non-zero number, the DAL guards via 'Output cannot be reduced below zero.'. A regression scenario should round-trip output → partial reverse → re-complete.

The MO → SO supply path is gated by materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsForLotInTx only at produce time and only when outputDisposition='available'. Producing to 'blocked' creates a lot but does NOT auto-feed downstream sales allocations, so a scenario that produces blocked then releases must explicitly cover the disposition path.
supporting_evidence: manufacturingOrderOutputs disposition CHECK at schema/manufacturing.ts line 349-352

inferences.claim: /output-allocation PUT cancels all matching active allocations before re-inserting. A concurrent shipment ship during this PUT can race because the route is not idempotent and the operation is not wrapped in beginInventoryOperationInTx — Phase 2 tests should examine concurrent edits and assert at minimum the final state.

Cost-basis-on-product tests must produce TWO MO outputs that hit the same lot (recordManufacturingOutput appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx) and assert the weighted-average effect on inventoryLotBalances.unitCost. Variance reconciliation at /complete then updates manufacturing_orders.actualCostPerUnit but not the lot's running cost — a divergence worth covering.

An invariant worth adding to kernel-invariants.spec.ts: for every batch-mode MO with status='done', the count of manufacturingOrderOutputs grouped by lotId should equal the count of manufacturingOrderBatches with lotId IS NOT NULL — i.e., one lot per completed batch.

unknowns: Whether produce-time materialization of MO source allocations preserves order across multiple promises with mixed inventory_lot vs sales_shipment_line demands (the for-loop processes oldest createdAt first, but the test surface for ordering is unclear).
Whether the SO-line allocationManagedAt flag is cleared when all manual allocations are removed (afterSaveAllocationsInTx always stamps it on save; reverse not seen).

Exact lifecycle of `inventory_expected_summary` after a batch-mode MO records output via /outputs first and then completes via /batches/[batchId]/complete with completesOrder=true. Two different release branches may double-release.

Whether requireIdempotencyKey on /pick covers the case where the override-confirm retry must use a NEW key. The helper testFetch builds the key from method+path+body-hash, so toggling confirmRequirementOverride changes the body and yields a new key — implicit but not tested.

Behaviour when a shipment line carries BOTH 'inventory_lot' AND 'manufacturing_order' allocations at ship time; consumeForShipmentInTx consumes lots first then throws on remaining MO promises (lines 756-768), but the order of evaluation across multiple lines and the resulting partial state is not fully traced.

Whether shipSalesShipment's syncAccounting=true path interacts with the idempotency replay (Xero push runs OUTSIDE the inventory transaction, so a replay of a replayed shipment skips the push — relevant for tests that check Xero outbox).

How updateSalesShipment's replaceShipmentLinesPreservingAllocationsInTx handles allocations when the new entries no longer reference some of the old salesOrderLineIds (was that allocation cancelled or moved?).

Whether reconcileIngredientActualsInTx's negative-delta branch (variance gain) restocks to the SAME lot that the pick originally consumed — the code reads pick allocations DESC by createdAt — relevant to FIFO invariants.

Behaviour of completeManufacturingBatch on the FINAL batch when intermediate batches recorded output via /outputs but not via /batches/[batchId]/complete; the completesOrder branch should release ALL remaining expected, but the order of releases matters.
review_focus: Confirm that every endpoint listed in api_files matches the BR-8a/BR-8b idempotency requirement claim (pick/complete/output require it; output-allocation, batches/start, MO duplicate, shipment costs do not). The downstream phases should not propose tests that depend on idempotency for the four exempt routes.
Validate that the held-vs-FIFO and requirement-violation 409 surfaces are testable purely from the public API surface (POST /pick body + 409 response shape).
Confirm that batch-mode 'one lot per completed batch' is observable via SELECT lot_id FROM manufacturing_order_batches and inventory.lots without needing to inspect inventory_events.

Confirm that shipping a confirmed SO whose only stock comes from a not-yet-produced linked MO produces a deterministic 409 (manufacturing_order promise blocks FIFO fall-through). This is the canonical 'wait for MO' scenario.

Review whether the gaps_in_context list omits any DAL function whose internal guards materially change the user-observable behaviour (especially `getMinimumLotAgeDays`, `getLotAgeAvailabilityInTx`, `releaseRemainingExpectedOutputInTx`).
Confirm the inference that 'producing to blocked' bypasses materializeManufacturingOrderSourceAllocationsForLotInTx (test scenario worth keeping; if false, the inference must be retracted).
Verify the unknown about syncAccounting and idempotency replay before any test exercises the Xero outbox alongside replays.
